title: I think reading this sub triggered my dream
content: Wanted to share my dream while it's still fresh in my memory. Ironically I found this sub last night and I think reading about the mall world maybe triggered the dream? I'm not quite sure, but I haven't had a dream this vivid in quite some time. So my memory picks up where I'm in a restaurant or pub of some sorts, very high end and feels like it would be in a nice sky scraper hotel. Im there for a cake for my birthday. A chocolate eclair cake, one which I've never had before in real life, but in my dream it's my favorite cake. I had a friend there with me and he and I are passing the time drinking etc, the restaurant is very full quite a lot of other people there. The pastry chef delivers my cake and somehow it's wrong, the fondant is not staying on the cake. My friend seems very perturbed by this and I say no big deal. He insists it is fixed proper. So he goes behind the bar and window and begins to fix it himself when people ask what he's doing he lies and says he's the owner. He also was speaking in French which I later ask him how he knows French. He insists we have been friends for a long time and is surprised I didn't know that. My next memory is at the top of the high rise hotel the rooms are very nice and I'm with my party. There are very weird appliances in these rooms? There's a black box that has differnt holes on the top with different varying sizes. Out of curiosity I spit into one and my spit turns into purified water. I did this in secrecy as to not tip my hosts off to my curoisty of the weird appliances. The hotel is on a beach and it's night time, I go out to the hallway and down to the end where there's a window to look out. I see people on the beach being chased and brutalized by police. I ask the party what we can do to help so they got some Roman candels and try to shoot it down at the police to stop them but they were stop short. I walk down the hallway again and note that all the doors were unlocked as I put my hand on a door and it opened but I stop as to not intrude. All of the rooms felt as if they were unlocked because they trust people there. It felt like I knew this all along and should have known better. That's about it. Sorry for the stream of consciousness just found the dream very weird and vivid and wanted to get it all down.
